Title: Beautification and modernization of railway stations under the Adarsh Station Scheme, etc. 

माननीय अध्यक्ष : माननीय सदस्यगण, मद संख्या 19,

माननीय सदस्यगण, इससे पहले कि मैं श्री एन. रेड़डप्प जी को आदर्श स्टेशन योजना के अंतर्गत रेलवे स्टेशनों के सौंदर्यीकरण और आधुनिकीकरण के संबंध में अपने गैर सरकारी सदस्य के संकल्प को प्रस्तुत करने के लिए आमंत्रित करूं, इस संकल्प पर चर्चा के लिए सभा द्वारा समय आबंटित किया जाना है । यदि सभा सहमत हो तो दो घंटे का समय आबंटित कर दिया जाए ।

अनेक माननीय सदस्य : जी, हां ।

माननीय अध्यक्ष : व्यवस्था से फिर समय आगे बढ़ा दिया जाएगा । 

आइटम नं. 19, आदर्श स्टेशन योजना के अंतर्गत रेलवे स्टेशनों के सौंदर्यीकरण और आधुनिकीकरण, श्री एन. रेड़डप्प जी ।

SHRI N. REDDEPPA (CHITTOOR): Hon. Speaker Sir, I beg to move:-

“Having regard to the facts that- 

(i) Indian Railways are one of the largest transportation and logistics networks in the world and are drivers of the socio-economic development of the country; Indian Railways account for one per cent of India's Gross National Product and serve as the backbone of core sector's freight needs; 

(ii) India has a vast history of railway development with an extensive network of train lines and stations built in the last century; Railways transport over twenty-four million passengers each day, connecting 8000 stations across the country; 

(iii) Railway stations in the country have evolved as key urban centres with commercial and infrastructural developments around over the years;

(iv) owing to the rapid changes taking place in the Indian economy huge investments are necessary to transform and modernise railway infrastructure; 

(v) various schemes including Model, Modern and Adarsh Station Scheme have been formulated for beautification and modernization of stations on Indian Railways in the last two decades and the priority under said modernisation schemes have been on improving passenger amenities at select A1 and A category stations only; 

(vi) there is an inordinate delay in the operationalization of the Visakhapatnam-based South Coast Railway Zone in the State of Andhra Pradesh with the Detailed Project Report of the zone is pending with the Railway Ministry; and 

(vii) there is no Railway Recruitment Board Beautification and Modernization of Railway Stations under the Adarsh Station Scheme, etc. 9 in the upcoming South Coast Railway Zone in the State of Andhra Pradesh due to which job seekers are forced to travel to the State of Telangana to appear for railway recruitment exams, 

this House urges upon the Government to- 

(a) take immediate action for the beautification and modernization of the remaining stations targeted to be developed under the Adarsh Station Scheme; 

(b) ensure modernization and upgradation of all the railway stations in the country; and 

(c) expedite the operationalisation of the South Coast Railway Zone and creation of a Railway Recruitment Board for the zone." 

Thank you very much, Sir, for giving me the opportunity to move the Resolution relating to the beautification and modernization of railway stations under the Adarsh Station Scheme, etc.

17.05 hrs. (Shrimati Rama Devi in the Chair.)

The Indian Railways are deemed to be one of the world's largest transportation and logistics networks. They are the drivers of socio-economic progress in the country, serving the freight requirements. With over 23,000 trains running across the country and connecting about 8,000 stations, the Railways carry about 2.4 crore passengers per day on average. 

Before moving on to the topic of discussion, I would like to highlight a few important contributions made by the Railways in our everyday lives to symbolize the critical nature of the topic I have raised. Since pre-Independence, the achievements like the growth of textile industry in Mumbai, jute industry in areas surrounding Kolkata and coal industry in Jharkhand, are largely attributed to the development of the railway network in these areas. Due to its wide network, the Railways remain the cheapest and among the most convenient modes of passenger transport for long distances. With freight revenues for Indian Railways being over $16 billion in 2021 and an 18% increase in freight loading as of 2021-22, the sector remains vital for long haulage of heavy goods like coal, petroleum, and ores. By connecting various regions, the Railways have also acted as an important factor in national integration. In this context, I take this opportunity to bring the attention of the House towards an urgent need to modernise our railway stations. As the railway stations have evolved as key urban centres with commercial and infrastructural developments over the years, aiding economic growth in the area, our focus should be towards better maintenance and redevelopment of the railway stations. Apart from the upgradation of infrastructures like the foot-over bridge and proper signage, there are some other important aspects that I would like to highlight in terms of the modernisation of the railway stations.

My first point is regarding prevention of accidents and mishaps. With a rapid increase in passenger and goods traffic, the frequency of train accidents has also raised serious public safety concerns. Owing to heavy traffic, overcrowding and a large number of people aiming for a single train, mishaps like stampedes take place.

As per the data of the National Crime Records Bureau 2021, the Indian Railways registered an increase of around 38.2% in accidents in 2021 compared to the previous year. Further, as per NCRB data on accidental deaths between 2010-2019, about 2.52 lakh lives were lost due to railway accidents. There were instances such as people falling from overcrowded trains; being hit by poles while hanging out of overcrowded trains; falling in gaps between the railway coach footboard and the platform; and trespassing on tracks within the railway station premises. 

Many of these incidents like falling from the trains or hitting the signal poles occur near the railway stations. The main reason behind that is severe overcrowding and improper measures for crowd control. Thus, I request the Government to ensure proper measures to control the traffic and prevent overcrowding through designated entry/exit points to the train. Also, there is a need to increase deployment of Police personnel to ensure congestion-free movement of people. The length of the platforms may be re-assessed to ease the crowd and also the number of train coaches may be increased wherever required.

Some other measures that should be taken for the modernisation of the stations are installation of proper user-friendly international signage and the segregation of arrival and departure points for passengers to reduce instances of overcrowding, thereby decreasing accidents and other mishaps.

Secondly, I come to safety of passengers. Apart from accidents, another important factor in passenger safety is, terror threats or the smuggling of illegal goods. Many instances are indicating such aspects, from the entry of terrorists into the railway station and attacking common people during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks to incidents of raids by security forces in which they have found drugs being smuggled between States.

Many railway stations have body scanners and luggage scanners installed at the entry points to identify weapons, explosives and narcotics. But many reports are suggesting that the scanners remain defunct or damaged for quite some time. The case of CCTV surveillance cameras is also similar.

Thus, in the endeavour to modernise the railway stations, the Government must pay heed to the security concerns and loopholes present at the stations. This should be augmented by investment in new surveillance equipment, assessing the functionality of the existing security equipment and engaging adequate manpower to do proper security checks, especially, at the entry/exit points of the railway stations. 

Along with this, the installation of full body scanners and walk-in security checks would ensure proper security measures are in place as well as reduce the crowding of passengers at the security check area. 

Thirdly, I come to the point of making railway stations accessible for persons with disability. The Ministry of Railways has launched the 'Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan' (Accessible India Campaign) in 2015 to provide persons with disability with convenient and barrier-free transportation across the railway network. 

But for several senior citizens and persons with disabilities, the railway stations and trains still lack in providing accessibility. The space on the stairs for getting on to the train is very narrow and there is a significant gap between the train and the platform, making it difficult for people using walking sticks to get on to the trains.

Further, without the presence of ramps for entry into the trains, PwDs using wheelchairs often have to undergo the difficult ordeal of carrying the wheelchair up and down the stairs.

Other concerns relating to heights of platforms, toilets for the disabled remaining under lock and key, absence of tactile flooring and prominent displays for passenger assistance information across stations, still prevail across most of the railway stations. 

With the value of the right to life and prohibition of discrimination enshrined as Fundamental Rights in our Constitution, the problems faced by PwDs become pertinent. Through this Resolution, I would like to shift the attention towards these issues and urge the Government to keep these in priority while upgrading the infrastructure of the railway stations.

Fourthly, I come to management of freight. The Indian Railways is one of the world's largest railways at the moment, with a network of 68,000 kilometres and dedicated freight corridors crossing the country. 

Reports suggest that the goods carried through passenger trains and vans account for only about 0.23 per cent of railways’ freight traffic. Other freight trains face many infrastructural constraints like the absence of separate loading/unloading space at railway stations, poor holding area/warehousing conditions, choked road access-points for entry of trucks and high transit time in railways due to multiple stoppages. 

Also, as most parcels are handled at passenger platforms, they obstruct commuters' free movement. With these issues prevalent across the county, I urge upon the Government to take cognizance of the matter and place special focus on better management of the loading/unloading points at the railway stations. 

Fifthly, modernisation schemes should focus on smaller stations. The Adarsh Station Scheme of the Ministry of Railways aims to upgrade the suburban stations in India to adarsh stations, but so far, the focus under various modernisation schemes has been on improving passenger amenities only at select stations. The development or redevelopment of certain railway stations of metro cities and important junctions as world-class stations being a priority, even the private sector investments are mostly utilised to develop state-of-the-art amenities to provide a world-class experience to passengers in these select stations. With an increase in the movement of migrants from small towns and the increasing role of transportation in the development of the economy, it is essential that the railway stations act as extensions for development across the country. Smaller stations are already very congested due to haphazard suburban growth around them. They often suffer from heavy traffic and cannot take any more new trains. Hence, in order to curb such pertinent issues at smaller railway stations, it is essential that they are upgraded with adequate investment and infrastructure development. 

Sixthly, I will talk about funds for modernization of railway stations. Modernization is not only about technological upgradation, rather it is about convenience to the passengers. The Government must deliberate on creating a dedicated Station Modernization Fund from which State-wise allocation and distribution can happen in terms of stations with heavy footfalls like the Vizag Station and pilgrim tourist destinations like Tirupathi Station. 

This must be a reserve Fund with the provision of carrying forward the balance year to year. It could also be utilized for maintenance and repair work at the stations. 

All the issues are being discussed to highlight the importance and an urgent need to modernize the railway stations across the country, I would like to end my speech by saying that the transportation of the future is not only about providing boarding and deboarding services; rather modern facilities such as automatic kiosks, functioning escalators and beautified station buildings are going to be an integral part of station services along with them, proving to be a mark of progress in the country. Hence, I request the House to pass the Resolution unanimously. 

Now, I come to my last point. I hail from Andhra Pradesh and it relates to my State. I would like to bring to the notice of the hon. Minister, who is here, that there is an inordinate delay in operationalization of the Visakhapatnam-based South Coast Railway Zone in the State of Andhra Pradesh as the Detailed Project Report of the zone is pending with the Railway Ministry.

Secondly, there is no Railway Recruitment Board in the upcoming South Coast Railway Zone in the State of Andhra Pradesh due to which the job-seekers are forced to travel to the State of Telangana to appear in the railway recruitment exams. 

Sir, this House urges upon the Government to take immediate action for the beautification and modernization of the remaining stations targeted to be developed under the Adarsh Station Scheme; to ensure modernization and upgradation of all the railway stations in the country; and to expedite the operationalization of the South Coast Railway Zone and creation of a Railway Recruitment Board for the Zone.

Thank you very much.

माननीय सभापति : प्रस्ताव प्रस्तुत हुआ:-

"निम्नलिखित तथ्य को ध्यान में रखते हुए कि –

(i) भारतीय रेल विश्व की सबसे बड़ी परिवहन और संभार तंत्र प्रणालियों में से एक है तथा देश के सामाजिक-आर्थिक विकास की वाहक है; भारतीय रेल भारत के सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद का एक प्रतिशत है और कोर सेक्टर की माल ढुलाई आवश्यकताओं के मुख्य आधार के रूप में कार्य करती है;

(ii) विगत शताब्दी में निर्मित रेल लाइनों और स्टेशनों के व्यापक नेटवर्क के साथ भारत में रेल विकास का एक विस्तृत इतिहास रहा है; रेलवे प्रतिदिन चौबीस मिलियन से अधिक यात्रियों का परिवहन करती है तथा देश भर में 8000 स्टेशनों को जोड़ती है;

(iii) विगत वर्षों में देश भर में रेलवे स्टेशन वाणिज्यिक और बुनियादी विकास के प्रमुख शहरी केंद्रों के रूप में विकसित हुए हैं;

(iv) भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में हो रहे तीव्र परिवर्तनों के कारण रेलवे के बुनियादी ढांचे को बदलने और आधुनिक बनाने के लिए बड़े पैमाने पर निवेश किया जाना आवश्यक है;

(v) विगत दो दशकों में भारतीय रेल के स्टेशनों के सौंदर्यीकरण और आधुनिकीकरण के लिए मॉडल, आधुनिक और आदर्श स्टेशन योजना सहित विभिन्न योजनाएं तैयार की गई हैं तथा उक्त आधुनिकीकरण योजनाओं के अंतर्गत केवल चुनिंदा ए1 और ए श्रेणी के स्टेशनों पर ही यात्री सुविधाओं में सुधार को प्राथमिकता दी गई है;

(vi) आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के विशाखापत्तनम में स्थित दक्षिण तटीय रेलवे जोन के संचालन में अत्यधिक विलंब हो रहा है तथा जोन की विस्तृत परियोजना रिपोर्ट रेल मंत्रालय के पास लंबित है; और 

(vii) आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य में प्रस्तावित दक्षिण तटीय रेलवे जोन में कोई रेलवे भर्ती बोर्ड नहीं है, जिसके कारण नौकरी के इच्छुकों को रेलवे भर्ती परीक्षाओं में सम्मिलित होने के लिए तेलंगाना राज्य की यात्रा करने के लिए विवश होना पड़ता है,

यह सभा सरकार से आग्रह करती है कि वह-

(क) आदर्श स्टेशन योजना के अंतर्गत विकसित किए जाने वाले शेष स्टेशनों के सौंदर्यीकरण और आधुनिकीकरण के लिए तत्काल कार्रवाई करे;

(ख) देश के सभी रेलवे स्टेशनों का आधुनिकीकरण और उन्नयन सुनिश्चित करे; और 

(ग) दक्षिण तटीय रेलवे जोन के परिचालन में तेजी लाए और इस जोन के लिए रेलवे भर्ती बोर्ड की स्थापना करे ।" ।

SHRI THOMAS CHAZHIKADAN (KOTTAYAM): Madam, thank for you giving me an opportunity for participating in the discussion on the Private Members’ Resolution on the subject ‘Adarsh Station Scheme’. This Scheme was declared by the Railways in the year 2009-10 and it is still continuing. More than 1253 stations were included in this Scheme. I am happy to note that eight stations in my Parliamentary constituency were declared as Adarsh Stations at the time when the constituency was represented by my predecessor, Shri Jose K. Mani, who is our Party Chairman. 

Madam, I also thankful to the Railway Minister for completing most of the works connected with Adarsh Stations. In Kottayam railway station itself, entire station’s outlook has become a modern outlook and people are very happy about condition of stations now. But still there are certain aspects which are to be completed in that station. It is the Sabrimala season, and last month only, hon. Minister of State for External Affairs opened the pilgrimage centre which was designed for the Sabrimala pilgrims who are coming via Kottayam railway station. That pilgrim centre is a very beautiful building which has a three- storeyed building with facilities for more than 900 pilgrims to stay for ‘verivagga’ that is what we call for the pilgrims. They have got the best facilities for this pilgrimage.

There is another multi-storeyed parking lot for the two wheelers that also has been completed under this Scheme. The station building has been re-modelled in the Kerala architectural model and it looks very nice now. But I have to point out a fact that people of Kottayam were demanding for a second entry for more than 15 or 20 years. We want construction of the second entry from the good shed site, and I myself have contributed from the MPLADS fund for fixing a ticket vending machine over there. But the Railways could not complete the civil structure which has been proposed to be constructed as a three storeyed building. I would request the hon. Minister to look into this matter and direct the concerned officers to complete that second entry building also at the earliest. 

This programme is very good. Ettumanoor is in my Parliamentary constituency. There was an old building which was situated on the other side of the road. Now, a new building has been constructed and the facilities have been improved and the station looks very nice now. In Chingavanam also, that station is totally re-modelled and that looks very good now. Kuruppanthara, Mulanthuruthy, Pirawan Road, Vaikam road is also having a better look now. But I have one request. Even at Ettumanoor, in the list of facilities being made available as per Adarsh station scheme, for example, In Ettumanoor, a new platform was built even though a canopy is made, but it is only covering partially the platform. 

The entire platform should be covered by canopy so that the passengers waiting over there need not suffer because of rain as well as sun. This work should be done at the earliest. Kumaranalloor is a small station where you have constructed a new platform, but the old platform that was the second platform is not raised properly due to which the passengers are suffering over there.

This scheme is very good, and I would request the Minister to look into these matters and give direction to the concerned officers to complete the renovation of the Kottayam Railway Station at the earliest so that it will have an international outlook with all facilities including escalators, lifts, etc. Two lifts are being constructed there for the past many months now, but the work has not been completed yet. 

There are seven platforms in the Kottayam Railway Station after completion of the doubling work. Earlier, there were only three platforms. I have proposed that there should be a Foot Over Bridge connecting the platforms. A new Foot Over Bridge has to be constructed, which has actually been agreed to by the Railway authorities. I would request the Minister to see that these new facilities are provided at the earliest. Thank you very much.

*SHRI JASBIR SINGH GILL (KHADOOR SAHIB): Thank you, Madam, Chairperson. Railways is the backbone of our country. Over 2.5 crore people commute by Railways. There are 8000 stations. Freight is being transported through goods trains in large numbers. Whether it was industrial revolution on green revolution, the foodgrains from Punjab are transported to every nook and corner of India via Railways. Railway contributes to the growth of the country and its share is 1% of GDP. So, it is essential to take care of Railways.

Madam, after Army, Railways is the other Department that has ample land with it. So, I urge upon the Hon. Minister to utilize this land judiciously. This land should be exploited commercially. All encroachments on railway land should be removed and commercially viable schemes should be made. It will lead to profitability.

I am sorry to state that railways, that has lakhs of employees, is represented very less by Punjab. I don’t know, why? I urge upon the Hon. Minister to recruit the youths from Punjab too for railway jobs. In the last 15 to 20 years, Punjab has been neglected. Please look into this.

The Railways teams are considered very good in sports. Once, the Railways hockey team used to be a force to reckon with in all tournaments. But, recently, hockey has been ignored by railway officials. This is double service. Sports talent gets a boost. And railways gets a good name. So, hockey should be further promoted in railways. Other sports should also get a boost. The railways teams in all sports should be strengthened.

Madam, Hon. Minister is here. Amritsar is such a city where international airport, international bus stand and international railway station are there. Over 1.5 lakh people visit Amritsar daily to pay obeisance at Golden Temple and they visit Jallianwalla Bagh too to pay their regards to martyrs. They also visit Wagah border to watch ‘Retreat Ceremony’ by our jawans. They also go to Harike Bird Sanctuary. However, there are many shortcomings as far as railway station at Amritsar is concerned. Earlier too, I had requested the Hon. Minister and some work was initiated. I thank the Hon. Minister for it. A G-22 function will also be held at Amritsar. So, the facilities at Amritsar Railway Station should be up to the mark. It needs to be upgraded and modernized further. Ma’am, Radhaswami, Beas is a large Organization. Lakhs of devotees visit Beas. Tarn Taran Sahib is another important place for devotees. Sultanpur Lodhi is a place where Guru Nanak Dev ji spent time. These are holy sites. So, these stations should be developed into pilgrimage centres.

People love railways. But, when we attend a railway meeting, they give us just a memento. If souvenir shops are opened at these railway stations, it will add to the revenue of railways. These souvenirs can be sold. So, please look into this matter. At cities like Amritsar, where 1.5 lakh visitors come daily, please build 100 room rest houses. Tarn Taran is a district headquarter. A border district where ISI and Pakistani agents are very active. Over there, it is main line where trains commute to and fro Delhi, Mumbai and Jaipur. The manned gates are closed there for long periods. City is divided into two parts. R.O.B. or underpass is the need of the hour. The problem will be solved. Please help us.

We have had a vision of being Vishwaguru today. We are the 5th largest economy now. So, our infrastructure in railways should be of a particular standard. It should be up to the mark. So that visitors are proud of it.

We have Shatabdi and Rajdhani trains. But, cleanliness level needs to be improved. Railway belongs to all of us. We should be proud of it.

Madam Chairperson, the Hon. Prime Minister has dreamed about Bullet trains. Work is going on between Ahmedabad and Mumbai. It has not yet come in North India. Vande Bharat trains are being launched. This is a good step. Its speed is 160 kms/hr. But, in North India, 90% trains run at the speed of 110 kms/hr. on existing tracks. 10% trains run at a speed of 130 km/hr. We must upgrade the tracks in North India so that high-speed trains can also run here. The Patti-Ferozepur 40 kms. stretch is there. The Katra-Mumbai train that plys on this route will be able to save 2 to 2.5 hours if tracks are upgraded. People will gain out of it.

In the end, I hope that Hon. Minister Sir will look into the just demands of Amritsar, Beas and Tarn-Taran and these stations will be further developed. 

Thank you. Jai Punjab. Jai Hind.

श्री संगम लाल गुप्ता (प्रतापगढ़): सभापति महोदया, आज हमारे देश के यशस्वी प्रधान मंत्री जी के नेतृत्व में रेलवे विभाग में आमूलचूल परिवर्तन हुआ है । जो बड़े-बड़े रेलवे स्टेशन्स हैं, उनको एक मॉडल के तौर पर डेवलप किया जा रहा है । रेलवे स्टेशन के बगल में जो जगह है, उसको पीपीपी मॉडल पर हाईटेक बनाने का काम देश के प्रधान मंत्री जी के नेतृत्व में हो रहा है । हमें मालूम है कि वर्ष 2014 के पहले मेरे लोक सभा क्षेत्र प्रतापगढ़ में एक रेल लाइन हुआ करती थी । आज इतना बड़ा परिवर्तन हुआ है कि चाहे हमारे यहां प्रतापगढ़ स्टेशन हो, देश के जितने भी बड़े स्टेशन हैं, उनको एक मॉडल के तौर पर डेवलप करने के लिए सरकार ने संकल्प लिया है । आज स्टेशन डेवलप भी हो रहे हैं । कोरोना काल में जो संकट आया था, उसमें रेलवे विभाग की एक बड़ी अहम भूमिका रही । उस समय रेल के माध्यम से देश के हर प्रदेश में ऑक्‍सीजन पहुंचाने का काम हुआ था । आज देश के माननीय प्रधान मंत्री जी के नेतृत्व में रेलवे मंत्रालय द्वारा स्टेशनों को एक मॉडल के तौर पर पूरे देश में विकसित किया जा रहा है, उसमें चाहे लाइन बिछाने का काम हो या अन्य काम हो । वर्ष 2014 के बाद देश के प्रधान मंत्री जी के नेतृत्व में रेलवे में एक बहुत बड़ा परिवर्तन देखने को मिला है, वह चाहे लाइनें बिछाने का काम हो या नई-नई ट्रेनें चलाने का काम हो । हमारी सरकार ने रेलवे में एक बहुत बड़ा परिवर्तन किया है और पारदर्शिता लेकर आई है ।

पहले ट्रेनें लेट हुआ करती थीं । जो हमारी रेलगाड़ियां हैं, वे लेट न हो पाएं, इसलिए हमारे देश के माननीय प्रधान मंत्री जी ने निर्णय लिया है कि देश में जितने भी रेलवे फाटक हैं, अण्डरपासेज हैं, उन्हें बंद किया जाए । यह एक बड़ा कदम है । 

अयोध्या से होते हुए प्रतापगढ़ से होते हुए प्रयागराज है, क्योंकि अयोध्या का लिंक चित्रकूट से है । वहां से सीधे चित्रकूट जाने की कोई ट्रेन नहीं है । हम माननीय रेल मंत्री जी से यह मांग करते हैं कि चित्रकूट के लिए एक नई ट्रेन चलाई जाए, जिससे प्रतापगढ़ और सुल्तानपुर की जनता अयोध्या से सीधे चित्रकूट पहुंच सके और उनकी यात्रा सुगम हो सके, क्योंकि, जब भगवान राम अयोध्या से निकले तो उन्होंने चित्रकूट में 14 साल वनवास काटा, इसलिए चित्रकूट से लोगों की बड़ी आस्था जुड़ी हुई है । 

हमारे यहां एक 81-बी ओवरब्रिज का काम बाकी है । उससे हमारे यहां के 40 गांवों को लाभ मिल सकता है । भारत सरकार ने उसे पिंक बुक में ले लिया है । अगर उस पर आर.ओ.बी. का काम शुरू हो जाता है, तो इससे भी क्षेत्र का विकास होगा । प्रतापगढ़ में रेलवे के कई काम चल रहे हैं । प्रतापगढ़ का रेलवे स्टेशन भी एक मॉडल रेलवे स्टेशन के रूप में विकसित हो रहा है । जहां भी देखिए, जिस तरीके से देश के प्रधान मंत्री का निर्णय है और हमारे माननीय रेल मंत्री जी की सोच है कि रेल से यात्रा करने वाले हमारे यात्रियों को देरी न हो और उनकी अपने स्थानों तक की यात्रा सुगम हो, इसके लिए बहुत सारे आमूल-चूल परिवर्तन किए गए हैं, ऐसे बहुत सारे कदम उठाए गए हैं । जिस तरीके से रेलवे में परिवर्तन हुआ है, इसके लिए मैं माननीय मंत्री जी को, देश के माननीय प्रधान मंत्री जी को धन्यवाद देना चाहता हूं ।

यही मांग करते हुए हम अपनी वाणी को विराम देते हैं । बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद । 

श्री मुकेश राजपूत (फर्रूखाबाद): सभापति महोदया, आपने हमें प्राइवेट मेम्बर्स बिल - आदर्श स्टेशन योजना के अन्तर्गत रेलवे स्टेशनों का आधुनिकीकरण एवं सौन्दर्यीकरण - पर बोलने का अवसर दिया, इसके लिए आपको धन्यवाद ।

महोदया, वर्ष 2014 में माननीय नरेन्द्र मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में जो सरकार बनी है, उस सरकार के माध्यम से देश के अन्दर रेल मंत्रालय के द्वारा अभूतपूर्व परिवर्तन देखने को मिलेगा । मैंने देखा है कि हम लोग जब कभी भी कहीं रेल से यात्रा करते थे तो मैं रेलवे स्टेशनों पर देखता था कि वहां गन्दगी के अंबार लगे रहते थे । वहां दोने, पत्तल पड़े रहते थे, थूकदान में, पीकदान में इतनी गन्दगी रहती थी कि एक बार उसे देख लेने पर मन घबराता था । अगर कहीं टॉयलेट जाना होता था तो वहां पर जाने के बाद भी काफी देर तक दिमाग से वह गन्दगी नहीं निकलती थी । आज हिन्दुस्तान के किसी भी स्टेशन पर आप जाएंगे तो आपको वहां आपके घर से भी अच्छे टॉयलेट्स मिलेंगे, घर से भी अच्छे वहां के प्लेटफॉर्म मिलेंगे । आप पूरे स्टेशन पर घूमिए । कहीं पर भी आपको कोई गन्दगी नहीं मिलेगी । यहां तक कि रेलवे लाइन के बीच का जो स्थान है, वहां पर भी बाकायदा सफाई मिलेगी और ढूँढ़ने से भी गन्दगी नहीं मिलेगी । यह अभूतपूर्व परिवर्तन आया है । इसके लिए मैं आपके माध्यम से अपने देश के यशस्वी प्रधान मंत्री जी का आभार व्यक्त करता हूं और हमारे जो मंत्री जी हैं, उनका भी मैं आभार व्यक्त करता हूं । अब स्टेशन साफ-सुथरे हुए हैं । 

यात्रियों की सुविधाओं के संबंध में मैंने देखा है कि जो प्लेटफार्म्स जीर्णशीर्ण थे, कहीं टीन शेड टूटा हुआ था, बरसात का पूरा पानी प्लेटफार्म पर आता था, लोगों के बैठने के लिए बेंचेज़ नहीं थीं, यात्रियों के ठहरने के लिए स्टेशन पर कोई व्यवस्था नहीं थी । इन सभी सुविधाओं में भी अभूतपूर्व परिवर्तन आया है ।

महोदया, देश के अंदर लगभग 8 हजार स्टेशंस हैं । उन 8 हजार स्टेशंस में, जिस तरह से पूरे देश के लोग यात्रा कर रहे हैं, यह अपने में एक कीर्तिमान स्थापित करता है । जब हम स्टेशन में जाते हैं और सफर करते हैं तो एक चलता-फिरता भारत दिखाई देता है । यातायात के साधन हों या माल ढुलाई का माध्यम हो, वह सब काम रेल विभाग के माध्यम से ही हो रहा है । 

कोरोना काल के समय में लॉकडाउन लगा । लॉकडाउन के समय में लोगों के पास खाद्यान्न पहुंचाना था । ऑक्सीजन की कमी थी, तो ऑक्सीजन भी पहुंचानी थी । कहीं पर भी खाद्यान्न की कोई कमी नहीं हुई । किसानों के लिए चाहे यूरिया हो, डीएपी हो, हमारे जो रासायनिक उर्वरक हैं, वे भी समय से किसानों तक पहुंचाये गए । गरीबों के पास खाद्यान्न पहुंचाने के लिए रेल मंत्रालय द्वारा खाद्यान्न की ढुलाई की गई । रेल मंत्रालय के द्वारा यात्रियों की सुविधाओं के साथ-साथ किसानों की मदद की गई । कोरोना काल में किसान अपने उत्पाद को देश की विभिन्न मंडियों में ले जाकर बेचें, इसके लिए रेल मंत्रालय ने किसान रेल के माध्यम से कम रेट में, आधे किराये पर किसानों को सुविधा दी, जिससे उसकी फसलें खराब न हों । हरी सब्ज‍ियां, कच्ची सब्जियां हैं, ये सब्जियां दूरगामी क्षेत्र में ताजी उपलब्ध हों, इसके लिए रेल मंत्रालय ने किसानों और उपभोक्ताओं के लिए जो सुविधायें उपलब्ध कराईं, वह भी किसी से छिपा नहीं है । इससे किसानों को उनके उत्पादन का लाभकारी मूल्य मिला और किसानों की आय दुगुना होने में भी सहायक हुआ ।

कोरोना काल में इसमें एंबुलेंस का भी काम किया गया । जब कहीं पर भी कोई अस्पताल किसी को एवलेबल नहीं हो रहा था, तो कोरोना काल की बोगी को मॉडीफाइड करके अस्पताल के रूम में चेंज किया गया । इससे जो लोग अस्पताल में नहीं जा सकते थे, उनको वहां सुविधा मिली । ऐसे लोगों की कोरोना काल में रेल मंत्रालय के द्वारा सेवा की गई, वह भी स्मरणीय है । 

पूरे देश में अपना जनपद छोड़कर जो दूसरी जगह जॉब करते थे, दूसरी जगह रहते हुए लॉकडाउन लगने के समय वे अपने क्षेत्रों में नहीं पहुंच पा रहे थे । घर वाले चिंतित थे कि हमारे परिजन कैसे होंगे, हमारा घर का मुखिया कैसा होगा? घर के मुखिया को चिंता थी कि हमारा परिवार कैसा होगा? इन दोनों को उनके घर तक पहुंचाने के लिए, हमारे देश के अंदर जो श्रमिक थे, उनको विभिन्न शहरों से, महानगरों से उनके घर तक पहुंचाने में रेल मंत्रालय ने जो योगदान किया, उसके लिए मैं उन श्रमिकों के माध्यम से माननीय मंत्री जी का आभार व्यक्त करता हूं कि उन्होंने श्रमिकों, लोगों की अच्छी तरह से सेवा की । 

रेल स्टेशनों पर बहुत एन्क्रोचमेंट है । जब मैं पश्चिम बंगाल गया तो देखा कि कई स्टेशनों पर काफी एन्क्रोचमेंट है । जो साथी प्राइवेट मेंबर्स बिल लाए हैं, वे भी मेरे साथ थे । वहां इतना एन्क्रोचमेंट था कि उस इन्क्रोचमेंट को देखकर ऐसा लग रहा था कि हम कहीं मार्केट में आ गए हैं । हम लोग रेल मंत्रालय की तरफ से पूरे भारत में जहां भी गए, वहां इस तरह की व्यवस्था नहीं देखी जैसी व्यवस्था पश्चिम बंगाल में देखने को मिली । भीड़भाड़ वाली स्टेशन पर भी एन्क्रोचमेंट है । 

मेरा आपके माध्यम से माननीय रेल मंत्री जी से अुनरोध है कि जहां-जहां प्लेटफार्म पर एन्क्रोचमेंट है, उस एन्क्रोचमेंट को हटाना चाहिए । मैंने देखा कि प्लेटफार्म पर ही दुकानें हैं, कुछ लोग झोपड़ी में रहने लगे हैं । जब वे वहां रहेंगे और जब यात्री को ट्रेन पकड़नी है तो वह भीड़भाड़ वाली स्टेशन पर कैसे ट्रेन पकड़ सकता है? यह लोगों के आवागमन में बहुत बड़ी असुविधा बनी हुई है ।

मेरा आपके माध्यम से पुन: रेल मंत्री जी से अनुरोध है कि उस एन्क्रोचमेंट को हटाया जाए जिससे लोगों को आने-जाने में सुविधा हो सके । प्रयागराज में जब कुम्भ का मेला हुआ, उस कुम्भ मेले में जिस तरह से रेल मंत्रालय द्वारा व्यवस्थाएं की गईं, व‍ह किसी से छिपी नहीं है । पहले जब कुम्भ मेला लगता था तो कई घटनाएं और दुर्घटनाएं होती थीं । मेले के लिए काफी स्पेशल ट्रेनें चलाई गईं । कहीं एक भी कैजुअलटी नहीं हुई, यात्रियों को कुम्भ में आने-जाने के लिए ट्रेन से जैसी सुविधा मिली, वह उनके अपने निजी वाहनों से भी नहीं मिली । भारत सरकार ने प्रयागराज में कुम्भ मेले में जिस प्रकार से व्यवस्था की थी, मैं आशा करता हूं कि आगे आने वाले समय में इस तरह की व्यवस्थाएं रेल मंत्रालय करेगा ।

मैं एक सुझाव देना चाहता हूं, मैंने देखा है कि बहुत सारे छोटे स्टेशन्स हैं, जो आदर्श स्टेशन्स हो गए हैं, लेकिन जब वहां बुजुर्ग लोग आते हैं तो वहां स्वचालित सीढ़ियां नहीं होती हैं । जो बीमार हैं, वृद्ध हैं, एक स्टेशन से दूसरे प्लेटफार्म पर जाने के लिए लोगों को स्वचालित सीढ़ियां मिलें, लेकिन, ये स्टेशन ए कैटगरी में नहीं आते हैं, ऐसे में वहां स्वचालित सीढ़िया नहीं बन सकती हैं । 

मेरा आपके माध्यम से रेल मंत्री जी से आग्रह है कि कम से कम लिफ्ट सिस्टम ही वहां हो जाए, जिससे कम से कम वृद्ध यात्री या अस्वस्थ व्यक्ति लिफ्ट के माध्यम से ऊपर जा सकता है और अपनी यात्रा को सुगम बना सकता है । 

मैं आपके माध्यम से माननीय रेल मंत्री जी से अनुरोध करूंगा कि इस तरह के स्टेशनों को सुविधाजनक बनाया जाए । आज से 30-40 साल पहले कुछ स्टेशन काफी डेवलप्ड थी, लेकिन वहां धीरे-धीरे सुविधाएं न मिलने के कारण कुछ स्टेशनों को प्राइवेटाइज्ड कर दिया गया । वेंडर्स को स्टेशन दे दिए गए, जब वेंडर्स के हाथ में स्टेशन चली जाती है तो वहां की सुविधा भी वेंडर्स के हाथ में आ जाती है । 

मैं बताना चाहता हूं कि वहां वेंडर्स यात्रियों की सुविधाओं पर ध्यान नहीं देते । प्लेटफार्म टूट गया, छत टूट गई या टॉयलेट खराब है, ऐसे स्टेशन जो वेंडर्स को दिए गए हैं, रेल मंत्रालय को अपनी देखरेख में उनकी मॉनिटरिंग करनी चाहिए । 

यात्री तो यात्री है, जब वह देखता है कि बड़े स्टेशनों पर ये सुविधाएं मिल रही हैं और गांव के स्टेशनों पर कोई सुविधा नहीं मिल रही है तो उसे फर्क लगता है क्योंकि वह भी तो हिन्दुस्तान में ही है । मेरा आपके माध्यम से अनुरोध है कि उनका भी ख्याल रखा जाए ।

मैं आपके माध्यम से एक और अनुरोध करना चाहता हूं । माल ढुलाई के लिए माल गोदाम होते हैं और लोडिंग-अनलोडिंग के लिए अलग से प्लेटफार्म होता है । अब कई गुना यात्री भी बढ़ गए हैं । एक ही स्टेशन से यात्रा, माल ढुलाई की लोडिंग-अनलोडिंग, ट्रकों और ट्रेक्टरों के कारण जाम की स्थिति बन जाती है, एक्सीडेंट्स होते हैं और यात्रियों को भी असुविधा होती है । 

मेरा एक और छोटा सा अनुरोध है, खाद, सीमेंट, अनाज, फल या सब्जियों की लोडिंग के लिए, जहां बड़े रैक्स आते और जाते हैं, स्टेशन शहर से लगे होने चाहिए । माल ढुलाई स्टेशन को 10 या 15 किलोमीटर की रेंज में, जहां रेलवे विभाग की जमीनें हैं, आने-जाने की सुविधा है, ऐसे स्टेशनों को डेवलप किया जाए । इससे ढुलाई भी समय से हो जाएगी और स्थानीय लोगों को भी परेशानी नहीं होगी । यहां तक कि यात्रा करने वाले लोगों को भी किसी तरह की कोई समस्या नहीं होगी । मैं आपके माध्यम से रेल मंत्री जी से अनुरोध करता हूं कि जनहित और यात्रियों के हित को ध्यान में रखते हुए सर्वे कराकर इसे ठीक कराने का काम करें ।

सभापति जी, मैंने कई बार आपके माध्यम से माननीय मंत्री जी का ध्यान आकृष्ट किया है ‍कि फर्रुखाबाद और कानपुर के बीच में कालिंदी एक्सप्रेस ट्रेन चलती है और यह दिल्ली तक आती है । यह ट्रेन फर्रुखाबाद से आती है, फिर मेनपुरी, टुंडला, अलीगढ़ और दिल्ली आती है । हम लोगों को उस ट्रेन में 10-12 घंटे यात्रा करनी पड़ती है और फिर हम दिल्ली में आ पाते हैं । फर्रुखाबाद से दिल्ली की दूरी मात्र 350 किलोमीटर है । मेरा आपके माध्यम से माननीय मंत्री जी छोटा सा अनुरोध है कि यदि हम अलीगढ़ से सीधा कासगंज जोड़ दें तो मात्र 52 किलोमीटर नई रेलवे लाइन बिछानी होगी । रेलवे लाइन प्रारंभ हो जाएगी तो जो सफर हमें 10-12 घंटे करना पड़ता है, उसका समय घटकर चार या पांच घंटे रह जाएगा । इससे कानपुर देहात, कन्नौज, फर्रुखाबाद, कासगंज चार पांच लोकसभा क्षेत्रों को इससे बेनिफिट मिलेगा । सीधी ट्रेन का संचालन होने से समय बचेगा । यही मैं आपके माध्यम से माननीय मंत्री जी से अनुरोध करता हूं । हमारे साथी बिल लाए हैं और माननीय मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में माननीय मंत्री जी काम कर रहे हैं, रेलवे मंत्रालय और स्टेशनों को आदर्श बनाने में अपना पूरा योगदान दे रहे हैं ।

पिछली सरकारों ने जो काम नहीं किया, वह काम इन आठ सालों में हुआ है और आगे भी शेष काम होंगे । मैं इन्हीं शब्दों के साथ आपका पुनः बहुत-बहुत आभार व्यक्त करता हूं ।

माननीय सभापति : सभा की कार्यवाही सोमवार, दिनांक 19 दिसम्बर, 2022 को प्रात: ग्यारह बजे तक के लिए स्थगित की जाती है ।

18.00 hrs

आइटम नम्बर-2, डॉ. जितेन्द्र सिंह ।

विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी मंत्रालय के राज्य मंत्री; पृथ्वी विज्ञान मंत्रालय के राज्य मंत्री; प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय में राज्य मंत्री; कार्मिक, लोक शिकायत और पेंशन मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री; परमाणु ऊर्जा विभाग में राज्य मंत्री तथा अंतरिक्ष विभाग में राज्य मंत्री (डॉ. जितेन्द्र सिंह): महोदय, मैं निम्नलिखित पत्र सभा पटल पर रखता हूं:-

Title: Secretary General informed Lok Sabha that (1) Rajya Sabha agreed without any amendment to the Energy Conservation (Amendment) Bill, 2022 passed by the Lok Sabha at its sitting held on the 8th August, 2022 (ii) Shri V. Vijayasai Reddy, Member, Rajya Sabha has been duly elected to the Committee on Public Accounts, and (iii) Shri Masthan Rao Beeda,Shri Mahesh Jethmalani,Shrimati Sulata Deo have been duly elected to the Joint Committee on Offices of Profit. 

SECRETARY GENERAL: Sir, I have to report the following message received from the Secretary General of Rajya Sabha:-

“In accordance with the provisions of rule 127 of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Rajya Sabha, I am directed to inform the Lok Sabha that the Rajya Sabha at its sitting held on the 12th December, 2022 agreed without any amendment to the Energy Conservation (Amendment) Bill, 2022 which was passed by the Lok Sabha at its sitting held on the 8th August, 2022.”

Sir, I have to report following messages received from the Secretary General of Rajya Sabha:-

(i) ‘I am directed to inform the Lok Sabha that the Rajya Sabha at its sitting held on Friday, the 5th August, 2022 adopted the following Motion in regard to the Committee on Public Accounts:-

“That this House concurs in the recommendation of the Lok Sabha that the Rajya Sabha do agree to nominate one Member from Rajya Sabha vice Shri V. Vijayasai Reddy, retired from the Rajya Sabha on 21.06.2022, to associate with the Committee on Public Accounts for the remaining period of the term of the Committee and do proceed to elect, in the manner as directed by the Chairman, one Member from amongst the Members of this House to serve on the said Committee.”

2. I am further to inform the Lok Sabha that in pursuance of the above Motion, Shri V. Vijayasai Reddy, Member, Rajya Sabha has been duly elected to the said Committee.’

(ii) ‘I am directed to inform the Lok Sabha that the Rajya Sabha at its sitting held on Thursday, the 4th August, 2022 adopted the following Motion in regard to the Joint Committee on Offices of Profit:-

“That this House concurs in the recommendation of the Lok Sabha that the Rajya Sabha do elect three Members of the Rajya Sabha to the Joint Committee on Offices of Profit in the vacancies caused by the retirements of Shri V. Vijayasai Reddy, Dr. Sasmit Patra and Shri Mahesh Poddar from the membership of Rajya Sabha on 21.06.2022, 01.07.2022 and 07.07.2022 respectively, and resolves that the House do proceed to elect, in the manner as directed by the Chairman, three Members from amongst the Members of the House to the said Joint Committee, to fill the vacancies. ”

I am further to inform the Lok Sabha that in pursuance of the above Motion, the following Members of the Rajya Sabha have been duly elected to the said Committee:-

Shri Masthan Rao Beeda

Shri Mahesh Jethmalani

Shrimati Sulata Deo

Title: Regarding issues related to financial assistance and hospitals empanelment under PMNRF.

SHRI K. MURALEEDHARAN (VADAKARA): Sir, Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF) in India is a fund raised to provide support to people affected by natural and man-made disasters. The Fund is also allotted to people for treatment of diseases like cancer, kidney transplantation, heart surgery etc. The financial assistance from the fund is highly inadequate. 

Every Member of the Parliament is allowed to recommend 36 cases per year for financial assistance out of the PMNRF. It must be enhanced to 100 cases per year as the number of applicants is increasing every year. 

Presently the financial assistance from the PMNRF is miserably delayed. It causes great difficulty to the hapless applicants. Many major hospitals are not yet empanelled under the PMNRF. 

The maximum assistance sanctioned from the Fund is only three lakhs of rupees per head. It is meagre to meet the rocketing medical expenses in India. The right to health is indirectly mentioned in Article 21 of the Constitution, and this has to be read with many of the other provisions of the Indian Constitution. The right to health was first articulated by the World Health Organization that enjoyment of the highest attainable standard of health is one of the fundamental rights of every human being. 

Hence, I submit that the number of recommendations an MP can make must be hiked to 100 per year; maximum assistance from the Fund must be enhanced to five lakhs of rupees per applicant; delay in processing the application and technical issues regarding remittance to the hospitals must be ironed out; and more hospitals, like the MVR Cancer Centre at Kozhikode, must be empanelled under the PMNRF.

Thank you.

Title: Regarding the need for amendments in the SARFAESI Act passed by the Parliament.

SHRI KODIKUNNIL SURESH (MAVELIKKARA): Sir, I am going to raise a very important issue regarding the repeated instances of use of provisions of the draconian SARFAESI Act. 

They have been excessively used to attach properties of defaulters, often through unfair and inhumane procedure, leading to helpless debtors or even their children committing suicide due to harassment and humiliation by the bank authorities. 

In Kerala State itself, numerous instances of debtors or even their children committing suicide, due to harassment experienced in the process of attachment of their properties by banks, are being reported frequently. The suicide committed by Abhirami in Patharam, Sooranad Gram Panchayat in Kunnathur District took place in my parliamentary constituency, Kollam. Her father had taken a loan from a scheduled cooperative bank in Kerala. It is a sad and unfortunate incident where a young student committed suicide. Her father had paid the majority of his loan, but that did not stop the bank from placing a board in front of the house and publicly humiliating the family. Such an old inhumane and archaic practice must be stopped once and forever. 

The financial position of people in Kerala has declined rapidly, and innumerable pravasis have lost their jobs. As a result, they default in repayment of their loans for no fault of their own. However, the SARFAESI Act does not consider the healthy repayment of loan by the debtor and the Administrator starts attaching the property. … (Interruptions) It declares the unfortunate person an enemy of the bank and an economic offender. At the same time, there are some big fish who looted crores of rupees from the banks and have fled the nation.

They ruin cashew factories, fail small-scale businesses, and the loanees who took loans to meet the educational expenses of their children are all facing the sword of SARFAESI Act where they will stand to lose everything. … (Interruptions)

I therefore, urge upon the Government, through you, Sir, to intervene and amend the SARFAESI Act which was passed by the Parliament.

मेरा आग्रह है कि आजादी की लड़ाई लड़ने वाले भारत मां के ऐसे सपूत को न्याय दिया जाए। आजादी के अमृत काल में ऐसे सभी स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों और वीरों का डेटाबेस तैयार हो। भारत सरकार उनकी समीक्षा कर, उन्हें सभी प्रकार की सुविधाएं मुहैया कराए।

आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य ने 18 आईएसओ प्रमाणित दिशा महिला पुलिस स्टेशनों के संदर्भ में एक सक्षम ढांचे की स्थापना के लिए सक्रिय कार्रवाई की है । पीड़ितों के मनो-सामाजिक कल्याण पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने के लिए 700 पुलिस स्टेशनों में महिला हेल्प डेस्क की स्थापना, 13 वन स्टॉप सेंटर, 12 नामित महिला अदालतों और 9 विशेष पॉक्सो अदालतों की स्थापना की गई है । कार्यान्वयन की निगरानी के लिए दो-दो आईएएस और आईपीएस अधिकारी विशेष रूप से तैनात हैं । दिशा ऐप संकट में महिलाओं के लिए आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया प्रणाली का व्यापक रूप से 19.83 लाख डाउनलोड के साथ उपयोग किया गया है । चूंकि आपराधिक कानून, आपराधिक प्रक्रिया और प्रशासन समवर्ती सूची का विषय है, इसलिए राज्य सरकार द्वारा इस तरह के महत्वपूर्ण हस्तक्षेप राष्ट्रपति के विचार और सहमति के अधीन हैं । मामला गृह मंत्रालय को भेजा गया है, जिसने इसे आगे परामर्श के लिए महिला एवं बाल विकास मंत्रालय को भेज दिया है । चूंकि यह महिला एवं बाल विकास मंत्रालय की अपनी सिफारिशों के साथ वापस आ गया है । इसलिए, मैं गृह मंत्री से आंध्र प्रदेश में एक मजबूत और प्रभावी न्याय वितरण प्रणाली के निर्माण के लिए मामले में तेजी लाने का आग्रह करती हूँ ।

Title: Regarding need to take proactive measures to stop sea erosion in the coastal areas of Puducherry. 

SHRI VE. VAITHILINGAM (PUDUCHERRY): Hon Chairman Sir, Vanakkam. Fishermen villages in the coastal areas of Puducherry are affected very much due to sea erosion. This sea erosion has caused damage to the urban and rural areas. Even the villages in the Karaikkal area are also affected. Particularly the villages in the northern part of Puducherry are affected due to Mandous cyclone which hit a week ago. Pillaichavady, Chinna Kalapet, Periya Kalapet, and Ganapathi Chettikulam are the areas which are severely affected. The livelihood of most of the fishermen has been taken away due to sea erosion. Fishing boats and houses of fishermen were severely damaged. We should protect the lives of our fishermen living in the coastal areas. This protection should be a permanent and long-lasting one. I urge upon the Union Government to take necessary steps and proactive measures to stop sea erosion and protect the lives and property of fishermen living in the coastal areas of Puducherry. Thank you.

Title: Regarding Development of roads from Sibsagar to Sonari and Namtola to Sapekhati in Assam as National Highways- Laid.

Title : Need to restore concessions in Railway Ticket Fare to Senior Citizens and to General Public travelling in the Special Trains introduced during Covid-19 Pandemic- Laid. 

श्री बिद्युत बरन महतो (जमशेदपुर): मैं सरकार का ध्यान एक अति महत्वपूर्ण विषय की ओर आकर्षित कराना चाहता हूं। वैश्विक महामारी कोविड-19 के पूर्व वरिष्ठ नागरिक रियायतों (Senior citizen Concession) के तहत वरिष्ठ नागरिकों में 58 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु की महिलाओं को 50% एवं 60 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के पुरुषों तथा पुरुष ट्रांसजेंडर सभी वर्गों में 40% का छूट ट्रेन यात्रा के दौरान टिकट आरक्षण का लाभ उन्हें मिलता था, जो रेलवे बोर्ड द्वारा बंद कर दिया गया है। यह ज्ञातव्य है कि लगभग ढाई-तीन वर्षों के बाद अब जब सभी चीजों के साथ धीरे-धीरे जीवन सामान्य हो रहा है। लेकिन रेलवे बोर्ड द्वारा अभी तक वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को मिलने वाली ट्रेन यात्रा में रियायतों की सुविधा को पुनः बहाल नहीं किया गया है। देशभर के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के द्वारा उक्त सुविधा को पुनः बहाल करने की मांग की जा रही है। आज जो युवा है भविष्य में वह बुजुर्ग होंगे तथा आज के जो वरिष्ठ व्यक्ति हैं उन्होंने अपनी सेवा देश एवं समाज के लिए दी है तथा वे अनुभवी भी हैं उनके अनुभव से देश को फायदा होगा। इसलिए उन्हें नजरअंदाज नहीं किया जाना चाहिए। इसी तरह कोविड-19 के दौरान देश भर की सभी ट्रेनों को स्पेशल ट्रेन घोषित किया गया था जिससे कोविड-19 स्पेशल ट्रेन के टाइम को रेलवे बोर्ड द्वारा हटा लिया गया है। परंतु पैसेंजर ट्रेन के यात्रियों से अभी भी स्पेशल ट्रेन का किराया लिया जा रहा है जबकि पैसेंजर ट्रेनों में अधिकांशतः गरीब, मजदूर, आदिवासी, पिछड़े ही ज्यादा यात्रा करते हैं।

अतः माननीय रेल मंत्री जी से अनुरोध करता हूं कि उपरोक्त मांगों पर सहानुभूति पूर्वक विचार करते हुए देश हित में रेलवे बोर्ड द्वारा जारी उक्त आदेशों को रद्द करते हुए वरिष्ठ नागरिक रियायतों को पुनः लागू करने एवं पैसेंजर ट्रेन के यात्रियों से स्पेशल ट्रेन के किराए में छूट देने की कृपा करेंगे।

Title: Regarding plight of the domestic air passengers at various airports in Kerala.

SHRI THOMAS CHAZHIKADAN (KOTTAYAM): Sir, through this submission, I wish to bring to the notice of the hon. Minister of Civil Aviation the plight of the domestic air passengers at various airports in Kerala. The air tickets of the domestic flights have become very costly in various cities of Kerala, and also in Delhi. The airline companies are exploiting the situation. The domestic air tickets have become a costly affair and the fare has gone up to Rs. 25,000 now. Also, tickets are not available for various routes. Due to special circumstances, even if we book the air tickets months before, the fare is three to four times the normal fare. Full fare is being charges on the children as well. The airports are jampacked with passengers. 

Train tickets are also not available. Hence, a lot of people including students are preferring to travel by air. The Malayala Manorama, the most circulated Malayalam newspaper, has been writing about the plight of the passengers for the last three days. I would request the hon. Minister to intervene in this matter and give directions to the airline companies not to exploit the passengers like this. It is the festive season. People from all over India are coming to Kerala for celebrating Christmas.

So, something has to be done. I heard that day before yesterday the hon. Minister of Civil Aviation himself went to Delhi airport to see the situation personally. Sir, this is a very difficult situation. I would request the hon. Minister to intervene in this matter and give directions to the airline companies to start more services and to reduce fares to a reasonable level. Thank you.

Title: Regarding Enquiry of a Private Compnay by a Central Team for causing Environmental Pollution in Jharsuguda district in the Bargarh Parliamentary Constituency. - Laid.

SHRI SURESH PUJARI (BARGARH): I would like to bring to the notice of the Government that Jharsuguda District in Bargarh Lok Sabha Constituency is facing the consequences of enormous environmental pollution mainly due to emission of greenhouse gases and faulty methods of fly-ash disposal by Industries. As per regulation, the fly ash should be disposed of in lowlands such as landfills for dry ash and in safe ponds for wet ash. It has been strictly forbidden to use agricultural land for ash disposal. It has also been forbidden to transport the ashes in open vehicles to prevent aerial dust circulation. These norms are being constantly violated by a pravate company in Jharsuguda causing serious health problems. Further, the heaps of ashes deposited as ash hills on open plain land get washed into the water resources contaminating the water and the animals in water such as fishes through which they enter the food chain. The ash is contaminating the crop fields severely hampering crop production and causing health hazards including damage to the male reproductive system and cancer. This is due to the high exposure of the population to the toxic constituents in the fly-ash such as Lead Cadmium, Mercury, Chromium, Arsenic, Molybdenum, Thallium, Silica etc. 

The Hon’ble Minister of Environment, Forest & Climate Change had directed the Central Pollution Control Board to cause enquiry which in turn directed the State Pollution Control Board to do so and the State Board gave a clean chit to the private Company without proper enquiry.

This was proved from the fact that the Green Tribunal, Eastern Zone, Kolkata on more than one occasion including one on 06.05,2022 vide an order in Original Application No-10/2021/E Z found the Company guilty and imposed a fine of Rupees One Crore with a direction to the State Pollution Board to regularly monitor it.

I, therefore, request the Hon’ble Minister to cause an enquiry by a Central Team comprising Environmental experts, take stern action against the erring Company.

Title: Regarding Need to give subsidies to farmers for purchase of Harvester machines.

डॉ. ढालसिंह बिसेन (बालाघाट): सभापति महोदय, आपने मुझे अवसर दिया, इसके लिए मैं आपको धन्यवाद देता हूं । जैसा कि आपको ज्ञात है कि इस समय पूरे देश में धान की फसल के बाद धान की कटाई में मजदूरों की बहुत दिक्कत आ रही है । मजदूर नहीं मिलने से किसानों को हार्वेस्टिंग कराना पड़ता है । हार्वेस्टर की कटाई होने से हमारा बहुत सारा धान का मैटेरियल रह जाता है, जिसको हम पराली कहते हैं । इसके कारण किसान को उसकी फसल की अगली तैयारी करने के लिए उसे जलाना बड़ा सरल साधन लगता है । इस कारण से वह पूरी पराली को जलाता है । इससे हमारी मृदा खराब होती है और पर्यावरण भी खराब होता है । आप देख भी रहे हैं कि दिल्ली के आसपास घना कोहरा जैसा वातावरण बनता है । 

सभापति महोदय, मैं आपके माध्यम से यह कहना चाहता हूं कि जो हमारे हार्वेस्टिंग करने वाले किसान हैं और जो हार्वेस्टर मशीन के ऑनर हैं, वे हार्वेस्टिंग के समय पर बंडंलिंग और भूसा बनाने का काम करें, चाहे गेहूं का हो या धान का हो । इससे जो अवशेष जलाने का काम होता है, वह बंद हो जाएगा । हमें इससे जैविक खाद बनाने के लिए भूसा मिलेगा, पशुओं के लिए भूसे की उपलब्धता होगी । इसका तीसरा लाभ यह होगा कि यदि किसान या हार्वेस्टर करने वाले हार्वेस्टिंग मशीन के मालिक को उसका विक्रय करना होगा तो वह उसे इथेनॉल वगैरह बनाकर, बेचकर राशि अर्जित कर सकता है । 

महोदय, हार्वेस्टर की मात्रा इस समय बहुत बढ़ रही है । किसान बहुत ज्यादा हार्वेस्टर लेना चाहते हैं, पर उनको उतनी संख्या में सब्सिडी नहीं मिल रही है या सरकार उनको उतने प्रकरण बनाकर नहीं दे रही है । हर एक राज्यों में ज्यादा से ज्यादा हार्वेस्टर खरीदे जाने के लिए सब्सिडी मिले और ज्यादा से ज्यादा लोगों के प्रकरण बनें, ताकि भूसा जलाने और पराली जलाने का काम बंद हो सके, पर्यावरण की सुरक्षा हो सके और मृदा भी जैविक बन सके । इस ओर ध्यान आकर्षित करने के लिए मैंने इस विषय को रखा है ।

Title: Regarding irregularities in implementation of ‘Har Ghar Nal se Jal’ Scheme in Chhattisgarh- Laid. 

श्री सुनील कुमार सोनी (रायपुर): मैं छत्तीसगढ़ की एक अति आवश्यक मांग माननीय जल शक्ति मंत्री जी के समक्ष रखना चाहता हूँ । माननीय प्रधानमंत्री जी के इच्छा अनुरूप केन्द्र सरकार की अग्रणी योजना जल ग्रहण मिशन के संबंध में छत्तीसगढ़ राज्य की वर्तमान स्थिति के परिप्रेक्ष्य में अवगत कराना चाहता हूँ । छत्तीसगढ़ राज्य द्वारा जल ग्रहण मिशन के अंतर्गत टेण्डर जारी किए गए, किन्तु टेंडर में अनियमितता के आरोप लगने पर जारी टेंडर को निरस्त कर पुनः टेंडर किए गए, जिस कारण से छत्तीसगढ़ राज्य हर घर नल से जल योजना में लगभग एक वर्ष पीछे हो गया है। अनेक गांव में पानी की पाईप लाईन बिछाई गई है, किन्तु पानी की टंकी का निर्माण ही नहीं किया गया एवं पाईप लाईन में उपयोग की गई सामाग्री की गुणवत्ता केन्द्र सरकार द्वारा जारी गुणवत्ता के अनुरूप नहीं है। कार्य में स्थायित्व नहीं होने के कारण से पाईपलाईन बिछाने एवं पानी टंकी निर्माण का कार्य विलंब से चल रहा है, जिसके कारण से छत्तीसगढ़ के निवासियों को पानी समय पर मिल पाना संभव प्रतीत नहीं होता है। अतः माननीय मंत्रीजी से निवेदन है कि केन्द्र की उक्त योजना का छत्तीसगढ़ राज्य के संदर्भ में उचित दिशा निर्देश जारी किये जाने का कष्ट करेंगे।

श्री संजय सेठ (राँची): सभापति महोदय, झारखंड हमेशा गौ तस्करों के निशाने पर रहा है । इधर हाल के वर्षों में गौ तस्करों के हौसले परवान चढ़े हैं । इनके हौसले इस कदर बढ़ गए कि कुछ माह पूर्व एक महिला दरोगा संध्या टोप्पो की कुचलकर हत्या कर दी गई । गौ तस्कर एक बड़ा सिंडीकेट है । यह देश भर में ही काम नहीं कर रहा है, बल्कि अंतर्राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर एक अपराध बन चुका है । इसके तार अंतर्राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर जुड़े हैं । 

अभी 5-6 दिन पहले झारखंड के मुख्य मंत्री ने एक आदेश दिया कि पशु तस्करों पर पुलिस अब कोई कार्रवाई नहीं करेगी । जो तस्कर जानवर ले जाते हैं, पुलिस उनको रोकेगी नहीं । यह आदेश गौ तस्करों का मनोबल और हौसला बढ़ाने वाला है । हम गाय को पूजते हैं । गाय हमारी मां है । यह धार्मिक आधार तो है ही, बल्कि वैज्ञानिक आधार भी है । हमारी हर धार्मिक मान्यताओं के पीछे वैज्ञानिक आधार होता है । यही वजह है कि हम गाय को मां पुकारते हैं ।

यह दुर्भाग्य है कि तुष्टिकरण में आकंठ डूबी झारखंड की यूपीए सरकार गाय की तस्करी करने वालों के हौसले बढ़ाने का काम कर रही है । अब झारखंड के गौ तस्कर गायों को पश्चिम बंगाल और संथाल के रास्ते बांग्‍लादेश भेज रहे हैं । हाल ही में प्रतिबंधित पीएफआई का समर्थन भी गौ तस्करों को रहा है । 

महोदय, मेरा सरकार से आग्रह है कि गौ तस्करी को राष्ट्रीय अपराध घोषित किया जाए और इसके लिए कठोर कानून बनाये जायें । यदि हमने समय रहते कठोर कदम नहीं उठाये, तो हम भगवान कृष्ण के देश में गौ संकट में होंगे और हमारी पीढ़ियां हमें माफ नहीं करेंगी । मैं सदन से आग्रह करना चाहता हूं कि मुख्य मंत्री का जो आदेश है कि अब पुलिस कार्रवाई नहीं करेगी, सदन उसकी भर्त्सना करे ।

Title: Regarding speedy implementation of PM Awaas Yojana and restarting the PM Awaas Yojana Portal in Banswara.

श्री कनकमल कटारा (बांसवाड़ा): सभापति जी, मैं आपका आभारी हूं कि आपने मुझे शून्य काल में अपनी बात रखने का मौका दिया । मेरा संसदीय निर्वाचन क्षेत्र बांसवाड़ा डूंगरपुर आदिवासी बाहुल्य क्षेत्र है । यहां पर लाखों की आबादी निवास करती है । 

उनमें से अधिकतर परिवारों के पास खुद का अपना घर नहीं है और वे कच्चे या टूटू-फूटे घर में ही अपना गुजर बसर करने के लिए मजबूर हैं । ऐसे परिवारों को पक्का आवास उपलब्ध कराने के लिए केन्द्र सरकार की ओर से प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना संचालित है । 

मैं माननीय प्रधानमंत्री जी का बहुत-बहुत आभारी हूं कि उन्होंने मेरे जनजातीय बाहुल्य क्षेत्र का ध्यान रखा और गरीब आदिवासियों को प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना के अंतर्गत आवास उपलब्ध कराया है । किन्तु राजस्थान सरकार की लापरवाही व ऑनलाइन पोर्टल बंद होने के कारण प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना के लिए पात्रता रखने वाले बहुत सारे परिवार अभी भी आवेदन नहीं कर पा रहे हैं और योजना से वंचित हैं । 

इस बीच राज्य सरकार द्वारा दो बार ऑफ लाइन आवेदन किए गए थे, लेकिन उसका सत्यापन अभी तक नहीं हो पाया है । अगर इसी तरह धीमी गति से यह कार्य चलता रहा तो वर्ष 2024 तक भारत सरकार द्वारा रखे गए लक्ष्य हासिल नहीं हो पाएंगे । 

मैं सदन के माध्यम से माननीय ग्रामीण विकास मंत्री जी से अनुरोध करता हूं कि उपरोक्त विषय पर राजस्थान सरकार को प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना के कार्य में तेजी लाने व पोर्टल को दोबारा शुरू करने का निर्देश दिया जाए ताकि पात्रता रखने वाले गरीब परिवारों को जल्द से जल्द आवास उपलब्ध हो सके । बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद ।

Title: Regarding demand for banning a TV serial on a Private Channel 

श्री हनुमान बेनीवाल (नागौर): माननीय सभापति महोदय, मैं आपके माध्यम से एक संवेदनशील विषय की तरफ सरकार का ध्यान आकर्षित करना चाहूँगा ।

हमने देखा कि आज देश में सस्ती लोकप्रियता हासिल करने के लिए जिस तरह की फिल्में, टीवी धारावाहिक आदि दिखाए जा रहे हैं, उनमें हमारे इतिहास के साथ छेड़खानी की जाती है । उस फिल्म या सीरियल को हिट कैसे करें, इसके लिए प्रयास किये जाते हैं । 

मैं ऐसा ही एक उदाहरण देना चाहता हूँ । सोनी टीवी पर पुण्य श्लोक अहिल्याबाई नामक टीवी धारावाहिक प्रसारित किया जा रहा है, उसमें 17 नवम्बर, 2022 के एपिसोड में हमारे राजस्थान के भरतपुर के अजेय योद्धा महाराजा सूरजमल जी के इतिहास को गलत रूप से प्रस्तुत किया गया है, जिसको लेकर राजस्थान सहित देश भर में महाराजा सूरजमल जी में आस्था रखने वाले लोगों और जाट समाज सहित सर्व समाजों में भारी रोष व्याप्त है ।

महोदय, इससे पूर्व पानीपत फिल्म में भी महाराजा सूरजमल जी के इतिहास को गलत रूप से दर्शाया गया था, जिसका सड़क से लेकर इस सदन तक हमने भी विरोध किया और तमाम लोगों ने भी विरोध किया कि इस तरह से नहीं होना चाहिए । बाद में, हम प्रधानमंत्री जी और गृह मंत्री जी से मिले और उसके दृश्यों को हटाया गया । 

मेरा निवेदन है कि इस तरह से सस्ती लोकप्रियता हासिल करने के लिए इस देश की रक्षा के लिए बलिदान देने वाले योद्धाओं के इतिहास को गलत रूप से फिल्म या धारावाहिक के माध्यम से प्रस्तुत करने वाले लोगों के खिलाफ कठोरतम कानूनी कार्रवाई की जाए ।

सोनी टीवी पर प्रसारित होने वाले पुण्य श्लोक अहिल्याबाई नामक धारावाहिक के निर्माता-निर्देशक के खिलाफ एफआईआर दर्ज करवायी जाए, इसके प्रसारण पर रोक लगायी जाए । इसके साथ ही, जिस एपिसोड में महाराजा सूरजमल जी के इतिहास को गलत रूप से दिखाया गया है, उसको सभी प्लेटफॉर्म्स से हटाया जाए और इसके निर्माता-निर्देशक पूरे देश से माफी मांगें क्योंकि महाराजा सूरजमल जी ऐसे योद्धा और शासक थे, जिन्होंने अपने जीवन में एक भी युद्ध नहीं हारा और हमेशा देश की अखंडता की रक्षा की और महाराजा सूरजमल जी का अपमान किसी भी रूप में देश में स्वीकार्य नहीं है । महाराजा सूरजमल जी एक धर्म रक्षक और अजेय योद्धा थे । 

मेरा निवेदन है कि राजस्थान पत्रिका एवं देश के प्रमुख अखबारों ने इसे प्रमुखता से उठाया और सरकार से मेरी मांग है कि सोनी टीवी के इस सीरियल को बैन किया जाए क्योंकि देश के नवयुवकों के अन्दर भारी रोष है और इसकी पुनरावृत्ति न हो ताकि देश की कानून-व्यवस्था न बिगड़ सके ।

Title: Regarding demand for Autonomous States-Laid. 

SHRI HOREN SING BEY (AUTONOMOUS DISTRICT): I wish to be informed about the issue that has rocked the hill areas of Assam during the past 35 years. The Union Government has been trying to find solutions by signing 3 political accords in a span of 25 years, the first in 1995 and then in 2011 and 2021. As most of the provisions of the accords remain to be implemented, it is not possible to make assessment whether the accords would resolve the political problems posed by the demand for Autonomous State in accordance with Art 244 (A) of the Constitution. Now that the Union Government is holding talks with the leaders of Eastern Nagaland and also with Kamtapur State demand groups, the voices of the long standing demand of Autonomous State are also being heard again in Karbi Anglong and Dima Hasao. As the accords are failing in their objectives, I appeal to the Government to reconsider the issue of Autonomous State demand afresh by holding talks with the concerned Autonomous Councils and other stake-holders.

Title: Regarding construction of roads in the Union Territory of Ladakh- Laid. 

SHRI JAMYANG TSERING NAMGYAL (LADAKH): The Union territory of Ladakh bordering with China and Pakistan is strategically very important for India having war experiences of 1948, 1962, 1965, 1971, 1999 and the Galwan conflict of 2020. Some more option after commendable works on Nimo-Padum-Darcha Road including tunnel at Shinkun La and Zojila to give better, shorter, and economically more feasible roads and tunnels need to be considered on priority to keep our border well secured.

I, therefore, make the following demand for road construction:

1. Construction of 45 km Paddar-Padum Road ‘Kishtward-Atholi-Maichil-Soomchan-Zongkhul’ or 80 km Road ‘Kishtward-Atholi-Maichil-Dangail-PotLa-Bardan’ to connect Ladakh with Jammu. This will be the shortest route between Northern Command and Pathankot Airforce/Military station to Ladakh as it will reduce the distance by about 150 km. This route being shortest was also followed by the legendary Dogra General Zorawar Singh during his conquests of Ladakh and eastern Tibet in 1830s.

2. Construction of Udaipur-Padum Road from Mayard Valley of Lahaul via Khanjar-Zardong-Kesar-KangLa-Padum or Khanjar-Shangkha-Thangso-Kargyak near Shinkunla Zanskar.

3. Construction of 100 km Road from Korzok-Kiato to connect Leh-Karzok-Kiato-Kaza-Kinour-Chandigarh will be an all-weather connectivity without any tunnel.

These roads can also help to connect Paddar and Chenab valleys of J&K and Mayard and Spiti valleys and help in creating economic potential along with other advantages.

Title: Regarding development of tourism in Kanniyakumari District-Laid. 

SHRI VIJAYKUMAR ALIAS VIJAY VASANTH (KANYAKUMARI): Kanniyakumari district, which falls in my parliamentary Constituency is one of the most beautiful areas gifted by mother nature. Lush greenery surrounded by mountains on one side and sea on the other, has lot of destinations which attracts lakhs of tourists every year. But, I would like to admit that still there are lot of untapped potential for tourism. If developed, Kanniyakumari district will turn out to be a top tourist destination in the world map.

Lack of transport for the people visiting the southern tip of India is a matter of concern. An airport at Kanniyakumari will bring in more tourists who want to visit Kanniyakumari. The trains to my Constituency are minimal and hence people find it tiresome to reach destination. I request the concerned ministries to pay special attention towards Kanniyakumari district in this regard.

Further, Kanniyakumari has lot of temples, churches and mosques. There needs to be a holistic development of the surrounding areas which would attract more pilgrimes tourists to this district. 

During the Maha Sivaratri, devotees from all over the State visit all the 12 Shiva shrines in Kaninyakumari district. Pilgrims who visit our district make a point to visit these temples. These temples need to be well connected for people to be able to go from one temple to another. I request the Hon’ble Minister of Tourism to include this project under the PRASAD scheme for better connectivity and development of areas surrounding the temple.

We have beautiful beaches, if maintained, can be turned into world class destinations. With water falls and dams, it’s a perfect picturesque location which would generate lot of revenue for the Government as well as promote local employment. It’s a perfect spot for adventure tourism. Hence, I urge upon the Government to allot special funds under various tourism promotion schemes to develop Kanniyakumari district into a world class tourist destination. 

I request the Government to build a statue of our ex CM Shri Kamarajar in the similar lines of Sardar Patel Statue of Unity and this also would add to the tourist attraction.

Hence, I request the Government to do all it can to develop anniyakumari district in terms of tourism.

Title : Regarding increase in use of banned narcotics substance in Kerala- Laid. 

DR. SHASHI THAROOR (THIRUVANANTHAPURAM): I would like to know if the Honourable Minister of Home Affairs is aware of the alarming increase in usage of narcotics and narcotics-related cases in Kerala. During 2019-2021, the annual-average of cases was 6409, which has jumped to 16128 cases this year, just until August; similarly for arrests it has increased from 7693 to 17834. In September, Keralites were shocked when 652 drug-cases were registered within 4 days. Further, manufactured-psychotropic-substances are becoming more prevalent than less harmful drugs.

Most of the drug-supply originates in large cities outside the State and is distributed through organised networks using, inter-alia, clandestine freight-transport, courier-services and, worryingly, Malayali-students based outside the State. Instances of international-transactions through the Dark Web are also not infrequent. Data reveals that substance-abuse has increased among Keralas’ teenagers and students in the past 5 years. At the same time, the persons availing benefits under the National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction in the State has declined from 6642 in 2017-18 to 4887 in 2021-22.

Whilst a “No-to-Drugs” awareness-campaign has been initiated in the State to counter this situation, I urge upon the Hon’ble Minister to monitor the situation in co-operation with the State and inform the House of the measures being taken to eradicate the production and distribution of banned narcotic-substances.

Title: Regarding establishment of a National Small Crops Research Centre in Perambalur Parliamentary Constituency- Laid. 

*m 01 DR. T. R. PAARIVENDHAR (PERAMBALUR): My Perambalur Parliamentary Constituency and Perambalur District is a backward area in Tamil Nadu. Almost 70% of the people are agriculturist and are cultivating various small crops like, ragi, maize, corn and millets apart from rice, sugarcane, peanuts. Many farmers’ income and their livelihood are totally dependent upon the income arising out of selling these small crops harvested from their agricultural fields. But, they are not getting enough/good yield by cultivating the so-called small crops.

Title : Regarding inclusion of Rajaka Community of Andhra Pradesh into Scheduled Caste category- Laid. 

SHRI RAGHU RAMA KRISHNA RAJU (NARSAPURAM): The Washermen Community in the Country is being called as, Dhobis, Rajajkas, Chakali, etc. Though the nomenclature differs from State to State, these community people are mainly engaged in washing clothes. 

In Andhra Pradesh this community people are called Rajakas, who traditionally are engaged in washing clothes and in view of their backwardness still they have not been equally treated. 

There has been a demand for inclusion of Rajaka Community in Andhra Pradesh into the Scheduled Caste Category. Though the case has already been recommended by the Government of Andhra Pradesh long back, no action has been taken so far to fulfil the aspirations of this downtrodden community. 

In most of the major Indian States like Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Madhya Pradesh and Odisha, this community has already been included into the Scheduled Caste Category. I, therefore, request the Government through Hon’ble Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment to consider their request for inclusion of their community in the Scheduled Caste Category without any further delay for upliftment from OBC to Scheduled Caste Category.

Title: Regarding Establishment of an Agricultural Disaster Compensation Fund- Laid. 

SHRI POCHA BRAHMANANDA REDDY (NANDYAL): Every year, States in particular, face at least one severe flood which wipes out a significant portion of the farmers’ crop. Given that agriculture is an important sector for these states, sustained losses in their primary mode of livelihood year after year, pushes farmers to the brink. In 2021, due to heavy floods, a large quantum of chillies was lost in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, farmer suicides rose and the debt cycle also increased.

Additionally, the cost of agricultural inputs is on the rise. Amongst others, fuel prices have hit an all-time high and fertilizer black marketing has become extremely common. Farmers are consistently pushed into further debt with no assurance of any profits.

Special circumstances of disasters are becoming a recurrent feature, rather than an exception. In order to make the process of compensation, with a delineated chain of command, easier and more structured, as well as a right, an Agricultural Disaster Compensation Fund needs to be established at the earliest.

Title: Regarding Grant of Increased Pension to EPF Pensioners- Laid. 

ADV. A. M. ARIFF (ALAPPUZHA): EPF Pensioners have been denied their right for increased pension proportionate to the salary even after the favourable Supreme Court judgment on 04.11.2022. The Supreme Court has limited the benefit of higher pension proportionate to salary above Rs. 15,000 only for those employees who are members of the EPF Scheme as on September 2014, still it would be beneficial to a large number of employees. Even after a month of delivering the judgment, the EPF Organization has not taken any steps for issuing the operational guidelines to implement the scheme. As the condition for additional contribution at the rate of 1.16 per cent on salary has been invalidated by the Supreme Court on the ground that it is ultra vires the EPF and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1954, EPFO needs to clarify the alternative mechanism for the payment of higher pension. As the employees who had not exercised their option have been given four months-time to submit their option for higher pension, modalities for the same have to be worked out. 

So, I urge upon the Government to intervene in the matter and provide relief to the eligible employees of EPFO without further delay and uphold the Supreme Court judgment.

Title: Regarding Skilling of Women Construction Workers- Laid. 

SHRI P. RAVINDHRANATH (THENI): The construction sector has the largest number of unorganised labourers in India next only to the agricultural sector. Women form half of its workforce. Women join as Chitals or unskilled workers and remain unskilled throughout their working life span. However, men get training and systematically upgrade their construction skills. Studies reveal that informal women workers in India's construction sector earn 30-40 per cent less than their male counterparts. Women have the same potential like men to do masonry work. But Chitals are denied promotional opportunities in the construction sector. It is my submission to the Government that women construction workers be equipped with market-relevant skills to bridge the learning-to-livelihood gap and the gender pay-gap especially through the institutions like the Skill India Mission. Necessary legislation may be enacted to make it mandatory for the contractors to offer informal training to women construction workers in Government sites and employ certain percentage of women masons in all sites. I also urge that an institutional mechanism be established by Government for skill formation, and upskilling of women construction workers. These positive steps will enhance the resource potential among women construction workers and empower them leading to the growth of families and the advancement of our nation.

Title: Regarding compensation for victims of atrocities against SC’s and ST’s of Kerala.

KUMARI RAMYA HARIDAS (ALATHUR): Sir, I would like to raise an important matter here. Compensation for the victims of atrocities against SCs and STs of Kerala is pending. Several victims are facing different types of problems and challenges. They are waiting for this compensation to survive but the delay in sanction is leading them to stress and hopelessness in future.

The State Government has not disbursed compensation to the victims of atrocities against SCs since 2021. Even in Palakkad district, Rs. 50 lakh are pending to be distributed. Different projects and programmes to assist SCs and ST communities are pending, including Vatsalyanidhi which is a project for girls belonging to SCs, due to lack of assistance from the Central Government. 

So, I humbly request the Government to dispense adequate amount and share of the Central Government to the SC Department of Kerala for timely disbursement and implementation of projects.

सर, इस प्रोजेक्ट के बारे में रेल मंत्रालय से इन-प्रिंसिपल मंजूरी जून, 2020 में मिली थी और 28 अप्रैल को रेल मंत्रालय की तकनीकी मंजूरी, नीति आयोग और वित्त मंत्रालय से मंजूरी मिल गई  है । इस परियोजना की पूरी तैयारी हो गई है । ‍सिर्फ सीसीईए के सामने पिछले छ: महीने से इस प्रोजेक्ट का डीपीआर प्रजेंट होना बाकी है । मैं माननीय रेल मंत्री जी के ध्यान में यह बात लाना चाहता हूं कि ज़ोनल रेलवे का जो प्रोजेक्ट है, ज़ोनल रेलवे के तीन प्रोजेक्ट्स महाराष्ट्र में पिछले दस सालों से पेंडिंग हैं । इसलिए पुणे-नासिक सेमी हाई स्पीड रेलवे प्रोजेक्ट को जल्द से जल्द सीसीईए के सामने रखा जाए ।
